correctness.rationale: For the selfadjoint Schur mask, Haagerup order majorization reduces the norm to the least t with a Hermitian P of diagonal <=t and P±M positive. The displayed P has P−M=vww* with v=2(ab−1)/(2ab+a+b); its P+M zero-sum eigenvalues are 2, and the 2×2 constant-block determinant is exactly zero with positive diagonal. For arbitrary feasible P, part-permutation averaging and the two 2×2 PSD compressions force 2√(ab)≤√((p+1)(r+1))+√((p−1)(r−1)). Diagonal constraints p≤1+a(t−1), r≤1+b(t−1) imply t−1≥v for t<2. This independently reconstructs both bounds for all positive sizes. Symmetric limit checks agree. Independent finite PSD eigenchecks at (2,2),(2,3),(3,7),(5,9) are diagnostic, not the infinite proof.
